hero.title: Home cleaning you can actually trust.
hero.subtitle: Every cleaner is identity-verified and background-checked through Yardstik before their first job. You see the exact price before you book. We hold that amount on your card at booking and only complete the payment after the work is done.

howItWorks.title: Book with confidence. Come home to clean.
howItWorks.subtitle: From background checks to real-time tracking, here's what happens when you book with Sweepr.
howItWorks.step1Title: Every Sweepr is vetted before they can work
howItWorks.step1Body: Identity verification, third-party background check, and platform training are required before any Sweepr can accept a single booking.
howItWorks.step2Body: Standard clean, deep clean, move-in, move-out, recurring. Upfront pricing shown before you commit to anything.
howItWorks.step3Title: Track your Sweepr in real time
howItWorks.step3Body: You'll know when they're on the way and when they arrive. Your address is only shared once they're confirmed and en route.
howItWorks.step4Body: Every booking is covered by liability insurance. If anything's not right, report it within 48 hours: we'll send someone back or refund you.

services.title: Pick the clean that fits. Skip the rest.
services.subtitle: One-time or recurring, apartment or four-bedroom house. Every service is performed by a screened, insured professional.
services.standardDesc: All rooms, surfaces, floors, and fixtures. Bathrooms cleaned and sanitized, kitchen wiped down, floors swept and mopped. The kind of clean that resets a home without requiring you to be there for it.
services.deepDesc: Everything in a Standard Clean, plus inside appliances, baseboards, window sills, light switches, ceiling fans, and the spots that collect a surprising amount of history. A genuine reset for a home that needs one.
services.deepBestFor: First-time bookings, seasonal resets, or pre-event prep
services.apartmentTagline: Sized for your space, not a four-bedroom house.
services.apartmentDesc: A full clean tailored to apartments and condos. Everything cleaned thoroughly, without padding the time or the price for rooms you don't have.
services.moveInTagline: Start fresh in a space that's actually clean.
services.moveInDesc: A full empty-home clean before your things go in. Inside cabinets, closets, appliances, and every surface, so your new place feels like yours from day one.
services.moveInBestFor: New tenants and homeowners before moving in
services.moveOutTagline: Leave the place better than you found it.
services.moveOutDesc: Built to meet lease-end standards. A full empty-home clean including inside appliances, inside cabinets, all fixtures, and floors. The kind of clean that tends to get deposits back.
services.moveOutBestFor: End of lease or sale handover
services.recurringTagline: Your home, kept. Without thinking about it.
services.recurringDesc: Weekly or biweekly visits at a lower per-visit rate. You're matched with the same Sweepr each time, so they know your home and you don't have to explain it again. Pause or cancel anytime.
services.recurringBestFor: Anyone who wants a consistently clean home
services.addOnsTagline: Extra attention where you need it.
services.addOnsDesc: Inside fridge, inside oven, interior windows, laundry, organization, or a longer clean for a larger home. Add them at booking and your price updates immediately.
services.addOnsBestFor: Any booking that needs something extra

trust.title: The person cleaning your home has been thoroughly screened. That's not optional.
trust.subtitle: Background checks, identity verification, insurance, and training. Required for every Sweepr, before their first job.
trust.screenedBody: Government-ID identity verification through Didit and a third-party background check through Yardstik, both completed before any Sweepr can accept their first job. We re-screen on an ongoing basis.
trust.liabilityBody: Every Sweepr booking includes liability coverage. If something gets damaged, you're not on your own. Accidents are rare. Being covered shouldn't be.
trust.trackingBody: Know exactly when your Sweepr is en route, when they arrive, and when the job is done. Your address is only shared once they're confirmed.
trust.guaranteeBody: Not satisfied? Report it within 48 hours. We send your Sweepr back to fix it, or we refund the booking. No negotiating, no forms, no runaround.

faq.title: Good questions
faq.a1: Your exact price is shown before you book, based on service type, number of bedrooms and bathrooms, and any add-ons you select. No hidden fees, no charges after the fact, and no surprises when the receipt arrives.
faq.a2: Every Sweepr completes identity verification, a third-party background check, and training before they can accept jobs on the platform. We review work history and ratings on an ongoing basis. If a Sweepr's standards slip, they don't stay active.
faq.a3: Yes. Cancel or reschedule for free up to 24 hours before your appointment. Changes made inside that window may incur a small fee.
faq.q4: What if the job isn't done right?
faq.a4: Report it within 48 hours and we'll send your Sweepr back to fix it, or refund the booking. We're not interested in arguing about it.
faq.q5: Do Sweeprs bring their own supplies?
faq.a5: Yes. Every Sweepr arrives with professional-grade equipment and supplies. If you'd prefer they use yours instead, leave a note when you book.
faq.q6: Will I get the same Sweepr each time?
faq.a6: Sweeprs are assigned on a best-match basis, factoring in location, availability, ratings, and job type, so you'll always get the right person for the job. If you've worked with a Sweepr before and want to request them again, you can do that from your booking history.
faq.a7: Recurring bookings are billed per visit at a lower rate than one-time cleans. Pause or cancel anytime. No lock-in, no subscription.
faq.a8: Enter your address when you book and we'll show you real availability in your area. We're expanding regularly. If we're not in your city yet, you can join the waitlist.
faq.q9: How does Sweepr evaluate cleaner backgrounds?
faq.a9: Sweepr strives to evaluate cleaner backgrounds fairly, consistently, and with customer safety first. Every applicant completes a third-party background check, and results are reviewed under our published Background Check Adjudication Policy: objective written standards, based on convictions only, with individualized review where appropriate. Read the full policy at legal.getsweepr.com/background-check-adjudication.

cleanWithUs.heroSubtitle: Sweepr sends cleaning jobs to verified, trained cleaners near you. You choose the jobs, the hours, and the area. Payouts go straight to your bank, and tips are yours in full.
cleanWithUs.howIndividualSubtitle: Five steps from sign-up to your first payout. You can finish them at your own pace from your dashboard.
cleanWithUs.howBusinessTitle: How it works for cleaning businesses
cleanWithUs.howBusinessSubtitle: Bring your existing team onto Sweepr and fill the gaps in your calendar.
cleanWithUs.ind1Body: Tell us who you are, where you work, and what kinds of cleans you take. It takes a few minutes, and you can stop and pick up where you left off.
cleanWithUs.ind2Body: Short, practical training modules cover how Sweepr jobs run: check-in, scope, photos, and what customers expect. Finish them at your own pace.
cleanWithUs.ind3Body: Every cleaner completes a background check through Yardstik and identity verification before taking jobs. Your documents go to our verification partners, not to Sweepr.
cleanWithUs.ind4Body: You decide when you work and how far you'll travel. Jobs that match your schedule and area show up on your board, and you accept only the ones you want.
cleanWithUs.ind5Body: Payouts go directly to your bank after each completed job, and tips from customers go to you in full. Every payout is itemized in your dashboard.
cleanWithUs.biz1Body: Bring your existing cleaning company onto Sweepr. Add your legal details and the team members who clean under your name.
cleanWithUs.biz2Body: We confirm your business details and insurance before your first job, so customers know who they're booking.
cleanWithUs.biz3Body: Each cleaner on your team completes the Sweepr Academy, a Yardstik background check, and identity verification. Same standard for everyone on the platform.
cleanWithUs.biz4Body: Jobs in your service area are matched to your team's availability and skills. No ad spend, no lead fees.
cleanWithUs.biz5Body: Payouts flow to your business account with an itemized record for every completed job across your team.
cleanWithUs.perkInd1Body: Pick your hours, your travel radius, and the jobs that fit. There's no minimum and no penalty for saying no to a job you haven't accepted.
cleanWithUs.perkInd2Body: Your profile, training, and verification travel with you. Customers see who you are before you arrive, and repeat customers can ask for you by name.
cleanWithUs.perkInd3Body: Ratings and completed jobs build a track record on the platform. Consistent work gets you matched to more of the jobs you want.
cleanWithUs.perkInd4Body: When a customer tips, the whole tip goes to you. Sweepr takes no cut and no fee from tips.
cleanWithUs.perkBiz1Body: Matched bookings fill the gaps in your crew's calendar without marketing spend.
cleanWithUs.perkBiz2Body: Customers see that your business details and insurance were confirmed before your first job.
cleanWithUs.perkBiz3Body: Consolidated payouts and per-job records for your whole team, in one dashboard.
cleanWithUs.perkBiz4Body: Every cleaner on your team gets the same Sweepr Academy training and verification your customers already trust.
cleanWithUs.differenceTitle: We don't have cleaners. We have Sweeprs.
cleanWithUs.differenceBody: The name is a commitment: trained, background-checked, and verified before the first job. Every Sweepr is matched to work by location, availability, skills, and ratings, so good work leads to more work.
cleanWithUs.coverageSubtitle: See where Sweepr is live today and which areas open next.
cleanWithUs.finalSubtitle: Create your profile now. Training, verification, and availability can each be finished later from your dashboard.
cleanWithUs.faqBgQ: What should I know about the background check?
cleanWithUs.faqBgA: Every applicant completes a third-party background check before approval. Results are evaluated under our published Background Check Adjudication Policy, consistent written standards that consider convictions only, with individualized review in many cases and a chance to respond before any final decision. Read it at legal.getsweepr.com/background-check-adjudication.

teamNote.quote: We started Sweepr because hiring a cleaner shouldn't feel like a gamble. You should know who's coming, what it costs, and that someone stands behind the work.
teamNote.body: So that's what we built: verified people, exact prices, and payment only after the job is done. If something isn't right, a human on our team looks at it. That's the whole pitch.
